fields.description: hide wifi key information (including qrcode) - optional

fields.description: enable/disable led strip brightness - optional

fields.description: led strip brightness (range from 0 to 100) - optional

fields.description: led strip animation - optional

fields.name: available_led_strip_animations
fields.description: array containing what LED strip animations can be configured

fields.name: hide_status_led
fields.description: hide status LED (on supported Freebox models) - optional

fields.name: screensaver
fields.description: Configure the screensaver - optional Only present on boxes that have has_lcd_screensaver set to true in their SystemConfig information. Possible values are listed in the following table: Value Description disabled Display always on on Screensaver enabled night Screensaver enabled during the night

fields.name: use_planning
fields.description: is the planning enabled

fields.name: planning_mode
fields.description: current planning mode Type Description ledstrip_off ledstrip disabled

fields.name: resolution
fields.description: planning resolution (number of slots per day)

fields.name: mapping

constraints.true_means: planning in effect (disabled Wi-Fi/standby or disabled LED strip)

fields.description: mapping for planning : true or false mapping[0] is monday at 0:0 mapping[7 * resolution - 1] is sunday last slot (each slot has a duration of 60 * 24 / resolution minutes) The boolean value indicates whether the planning is in effect (i.e: ledstrip disabled)

fields.name: use_planning
fields.description: is the planning enabled

fields.name: next_change
fields.description: timestamp of the scheduled next change, according to planning

fields.name: mapping

fields.description: mapping for planning : true or false mapping[0] is monday at 0:0 mapping[7 * resolution - 1] is sunday last slot (each slot has a duration of 60 * 24 / resolution minutes) The boolean value indicates whether the planning is in effect (i.e: Wi-Fi disabled, or box standing by)

fields.name: display
fields.description: Display mode of this data display Description text This displays the endpoint value as text. Read access is always allowed when “text” is used. When write access is allowed, the text may be editable on user request. When the “unit” entry is present and not null, it specifies the physical unit associated to the endpoint value. icon This displays the icon fetched from “icon_url” with % being replaced by the string representation of the endpoint value. For string value type, the % is replaced by the endpoint value. For int and float value types, this requires an “icon_ranges” array of threshold values. The % is replaced by the index in the “range” array which is just below the endpoint value. For boolean value type, the % is replaced by “on” or “off”. When the “value” is null, the % is replaced by the empty string. Read access is always allowed when “icon” is used. Write access is not used. button This displays a push button. Write access is always allowed when “button” is used. A null value must be send to the endpoint when pushed. slider This displays a slider with the cursor located according to the endpoint value in the range specified by “range”. Read access is always allowed when “slider” is used. When write access is allowed, the cursor may be moved by the user. When write access is not allowed it may be displayed as a progress bar. toggle This displays an on/off switch. Read access is always allowed when “switch” is used. When write access is allowed, switch may be toggled by the user. A boolean value must be send to the endpoint when toggled. color This displays a color value. The value type is an int representing the RGB color. Read access is always allowed when “color” is used. warning This display the icon fetched from “icon_url” when the value condition is true. For boolean value type, the value is the condition. For int and float value types, this requires a “range” of size 2. If the value is within the range, the condition is true.

typed_scalar_union.name: HomeIoValue
typed_scalar_union.serialization: Explicit Utf8JsonReader/Utf8JsonWriter converter, no object/dynamic/reflection; source-generated metadata for owning DTO and arrays. Keep value_type separately; explicit null triggers must serialize as value:null.
typed_scalar_union.bounds: Integer width/float precision not normatively specified; do not silently lose precision. Null is not a missing field.
typed_scalar_union.pairing_variant: Separate HomePairingFieldValue null/int/bool/string union based on widget table; progress text ambiguity preserved.

architecture.request_response_split: Never reuse read DTO as write DTO. Presence wrapper for partial writes separates omitted from explicit null; RO resolution/id/hosts/current_mode etc excluded from setters unless explicit per-operation exception accepted.
architecture.fluent: Immutable selectors Adapters.ById(id), Nodes.ById(id).Endpoints.ById(ep), Profiles.ById(id).Rules.ById(rule); pairing Start/Next/Stop commands distinct even though method+path repeat. I/O only on terminal Async operation.
architecture.DI: One device/session state owner per registration; Microsoft.Extensions.Http standard builder/delegating handlers. Do not duplicate session for each domain. Named/keyed device configurations may generalize current single-device registration deliberately.
architecture.AOT_generation: Built-in System.Text.Json source generation plus explicit scalar/open-enum/optional converters suffices. For hundreds of repeated domain contracts, deterministic build-time C# emission from a reviewed normalized schema is justified; custom Roslyn generator only if its build-time benefits outweigh maintenance. Never emit from heuristic HTML or raw route strings without accepted variants/field metadata.
architecture.errors: Domain enums/value tokens retain unknown codes; structured Freebox error carries HTTP status, code, message, uid/details with generated typed known details.
architecture.current_version: Separate discovery box_model fbxgw9-r1 from SystemModelInfo.name fbxgw9-r1/full; shared closed BoxModels causes real-device discovery failure.

io_concurrency.pairing: Ordered session/page workflow, source refresh milliseconds, no automatic replay of next/stop/start.
io_concurrency.planning: Validate 7*resolution bool mapping; do not infer unsupported planning mode.
io_concurrency.sensitive_mutations: Reboot/shutdown/remove/unpair/override are explicit terminal commands, not executed during review.
io_concurrency.streaming: No binary/multipart endpoint in assigned sections; camera elsewhere.
